answer: A per-epoch proof-of-personhood registry binds each agent to a unique stake key, so a Sybil cluster cannot cross the dune of credential scarcity without fragmenting its own collateral across isolated jetty registrations. Recursive SNARK aggregation then compresses every identity attestation into one marble-hard commitment, letting peers verify the whole set in constant time. Colluding clusters incur an exponential slashing penalty bounded by O(Delta * S).
